description: Ghandhara Automobiles Limited, formerly Ghandhara Nissan Limited, was incorporated in Pakistan on 8 August 1981 as a private limited company and converted into a public limited company on 24 May 1992. It is a subsidiary of Bibojee Services (Private) Limited. The principal business of the Company is assembly and progressive manufacturing of vehicles including JAC Trucks, import and sale of Nissan, Dongfeng and Renault vehicles in Completely Built-up condition, and assembly of other vehicles under contract agreement.
